fields.label: 1. Name(s) of account holder(s)
fields.what_to_write: Write the full name of each person who owns the bank account.

fields.label: 2. Bank/building society account number
fields.what_to_write: Write your account number, one digit in each box.

fields.label: 3. Branch sort code
fields.what_to_write: Write your 6-digit sort code, one digit in each box.

fields.label: 4. Name and full postal address of your bank or building society
fields.what_to_write: Write the name and full address of your bank or building society.

fields.label: 5. Reference (from your bill)
fields.what_to_write: Nothing to write. The reference 1234 5678 is already printed. Check it matches your bill.

fields.label: 6. Signature(s)
fields.what_to_write: Sign your name. Every account holder signs.

safety_lines: Get free advice before you sign or pay. For example, Citizens Advice.

steps.text: Find box 1. Write the full name of each person who owns the bank account. Example: Jane Ann Smith.
steps.text_en: Find box 1. Write the full name of each person who owns the bank account. Example: Jane Ann Smith.
steps.picture_prompt: A hand holding a pen over a blank name line at the top of a paper form, with two simple person icons beside it
steps.say: Find box 1. Write the full name of each person who owns the bank account. Example: Jane Ann Smith. Take your time.

steps.text: Find box 2. Write your account number. Put one digit in each box. Example: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8.
steps.text_en: Find box 2. Write your account number. Put one digit in each box. Example: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8.
steps.picture_prompt: A pen writing in a row of small empty boxes on a paper form, next to a bank card
steps.say: Find box 2. Write your account number. Put one digit in each box. Example: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8. Take your time.

steps.text: Find box 3. Write your 6 digit sort code. Put one digit in each box. Example: 12 34 56.
steps.text_en: Find box 3. Write your 6 digit sort code. Put one digit in each box. Example: 12 34 56.
steps.picture_prompt: A row of six empty square boxes on a paper form with a pen above the first box
steps.say: Find box 3. Write your 6 digit sort code. Put one digit in each box. Example: 12 34 56. Take your time.

steps.text: Find box 4. Write the name and full address of your bank or building society. Example: Town Bank, 1 High Street, Leeds, LS1 1AA.
steps.text_en: Find box 4. Write the name and full address of your bank or building society. Example: Town Bank, 1 High Street, Leeds, LS1 1AA.
steps.picture_prompt: A hand writing on several blank lines of a form, with a small bank building drawn beside the form
steps.say: Find box 4. Write the name and full address of your bank or building society. Example: Town Bank, 1 High Street, Leeds, LS1 1AA. Take your time.

steps.text: Look at box 5. Write nothing here. The reference 1234 5678 is already printed. Check it matches your bill.
steps.text_en: Look at box 5. Write nothing here. The reference 1234 5678 is already printed. Check it matches your bill.
steps.picture_prompt: A person holding a bill next to a form, with a magnifying glass over a printed box, checking they match
steps.say: Look at box 5. Write nothing here. The reference 1234 5678 is already printed. Check it matches your bill. Take your time.

steps.text: Find box 6, the signature box. Sign your name. Every account holder signs.
steps.text_en: Find box 6, the signature box. Sign your name. Every account holder signs.
steps.picture_prompt: Two hands each holding a pen and signing a wavy line on a paper form
steps.say: Find box 6, the signature box. Sign your name. Every account holder signs. Take your time.

steps.text: Find the date box in box 6. Write today's date. Example: Friday 12 December.
steps.text_en: Find the date box in box 6. Write today's date. Example: Friday 12 December.
steps.picture_prompt: A hand writing in a small date box on a form, with a simple wall calendar next to it
steps.say: Find the date box in box 6. Write today's date. Example: Friday 12 December. Take your time.

steps.text: Get free advice before you sign or pay. For example, Citizens Advice.
steps.text_en: Get free advice before you sign or pay. For example, Citizens Advice.
steps.picture_prompt: a person on the phone talking to a helper
steps.say: Get free advice before you sign or pay. For example, Citizens Advice.

safety_lines_en: Get free advice before you sign or pay. For example, Citizens Advice.
